amo_summary.message: Generate and scan QR codes right in your browser. No accounts, no tracking, and your data never goes to any server. Codes for links, text, WiFi, contacts and more; scan images, page regions or your camera.

amo_description.message:
QRCraft generates and scans QR codes right in your browser. Your data is never sent to the developer or to any third-party service. Generate
  • QR code for the current tab, a selected link or text, or anything you type
  • Templates for WiFi networks, contact cards (vCard), email, SMS, phone numbers, and calendar events
  • Batch-generate many QR codes at once, one per line of text
  • Adjustable error correction level, image size, finder/module style, and an optional embedded logo
Scan
  • Scan a QR code in any image from the right-click menu
  • Select any region of the page to scan
  • Paste an image from the clipboard to scan it
  • Scan with your camera (camera access is only requested if you use this feature)
Privacy and more
  • History of everything you've generated or scanned, stored only in your browser, with import/export to a JSON file
  • No accounts, no analytics, no tracking. Generating and scanning work offline; the only network request QRCraft may make is reloading an image you chose to scan from its original web address
  • Available in 10 languages
Open source (MIT license): github.com/zenLoading/QRCraft
